d: Atrium of the house of Sallustio. The day rises. Festive voices from far away. Sallustio come, and Menenio in the table; then Public followed by 'Clients, and Liberti of Sallustio; finally Appio at the head of ' Magistrates, Seniors, and Patrizi.
The Handmaids, in the Octavia, and sayings. Fausto is at the threshold of his room.

Entrance to Pompeii on the side of Port Nolana. The people, festive crosses the scene, introducing themselves into crowds in the city, while Appio, and Public, are advancing, speaking with a quiet voice.

The temple of Jupiter, and later the two triumphal arches, from which veggonsi the districts, which introduce to the forum, and far from the various buildings of the city. On the left, a tribune, adorned with garlands. In double, and beautiful order, the pompous Corteggio is advanced from two arches. From one of these preceded by Magistrates, Seniors, and Patrizi, and followed by numerous Popolos is guided by Salustio in his big, and on the other the Matrones, the Handmaids, among which, though somewhat distraught, is Clodius, the Child, and the Dancing Youngs preceding, and surround the chariot, where Ottavia is seated. They both go up in the middle of the scene. The Great Priest, with the sacred Ministers, is already on the level of the stairway of the temple. In the middle is a burning altar, and a Minister carries a basin over the sert.
Portico of the great theater. They advance at a prompt pace, and watching Appio, and Public.

The Pompeians come from various parts, exhibiting the brands of the Custodi, who are at the entrance of the theatre, and introduce themselves to it. Thus the classes of the Patrizi, of the Seniors, of the Magistrates, and of the People. The Littors precede the Vestals, which with the great Vestal go to the show. Finally, Sallustio. Octavia, Appio, the Handmaids, Clodio as before, and Public at the time.
The Basilica. Appio, and Public from opposite parts.
The Soldiers are advancing, forming in two wings sideways, and behind the seat of justice. Chorus of the People, Patrizi, and Seniors. Sallustio, in the Middle Ages.
The People comes back with Appius, Publicity, Clodius, Handmaids, and Soldiers.
Garden of the house of Diomede near the walls. Fausto.
I'm restless, in the choir of the people.

Underground, destined for the torment of the rei, from whose porch you can see the road of the sepulchres. It advances slowly Ottavia, covered by black veil, in the midst of the Soldiers, and preceded by the sorrowful Handmaids. Sallustio follows it wrapped in its pallium, and concentrated: indi Appio, Pubblio, and Chorus of the people.
Best wishes, then the others, that will be indicated.
